correctness.rationale: Exact Poisson thinning objective; interior-maximizer first-order argument; strict two-level derivative and second-variation reduction; monotonic hyperbolic root for n=2; positive cubic direction at c=2n and negative Hessian just below; exact rational n=3 witness; high-load upper/lower squeeze plus coordinatewise uniqueness. value.rationale: Addresses a motivated multi-crossing resource-distribution problem with density-dependent adverse encounters; discovers the sharp n=2 versus n>=3 local/global asymmetry, a reproducible rational counterexample to naive equal splitting, and a one-heavy n-1-light limiting law. It separates locally stable equal allocation from globally optimal design without claiming field calibration.
